title: Families
hint: Every family using the app. You see counts only, never amounts or entries.
liveOnly: This page works only with real sign-in.
denied: Only the person who runs the app can open this page.
newHint: The admin signs in with this email, chooses their own password, then writes their name and picks the family's currencies. The family name is already filled in. If they don't sign in within 24 hours, the login is deleted and you can start it again.
passwordHint: At least 6 letters or digits. Send it to them privately; they replace it the first time they sign in.
created: {name} is ready. Send the admin their email and password.
counts: {members, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} · {wallets, plural, one {# wallet} other {# wallets}} · {entries, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}}
pauseHint: Nobody in this family can open their data until you resume it. Nothing is deleted.
resumeHint: Everyone in this family can use the app again.
loadFailed: Couldn't load the families. Check your connection.

errors.weak_password: That password is too easy to guess. Try another one.
errors.email_taken: This email already has a login.
errors.not_operator: Only the person who runs the app can do this
errors.failed: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.

waiting: Waiting for the admin's first sign-in
declineHint: No family is created. The family who invited them sees "Not now".
loginText: Your family is ready on the family accounts app. Open this link on your iPhone and sign in with your email {email} and the password {password}. You will choose your own password after that. This login works for 24 hours: if you don't sign in by then, the invite is cancelled.
loginCopied: Login copied. Paste it in a message.
waitingExpires: Waiting for the admin's first sign-in · deleted in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} if unused
